title: Full-Q charge-graded common domain and neutral refinement map

exact_scope.carrier_family: Use exactly the PAH-OMC-004 two-row strip G_n for n>=2, with the unchanged neutral coordinate restriction from G_(n+1) to G_n. No carrier, face subdivision or root family is added.
exact_scope.regulator: Use the PAH-OMC-010 path K=2, M_s=M_psi=1, epsilon=1/2, beta=nu=1, m2=0 and all displayed couplings one; R_max=R ranges over every positive integer. The map itself is independent of R.

state_definition.component: Omega_(rho_(n,R,Q),Q) is exactly the finite PAH-001 configuration set with 0<=ell_v<=M_psi and sum_v ell_v=Q, together with the unchanged aperture, phase and link constraints.
state_definition.admissible_charge_set: Q_n={0,1,...,M_psi|V_n|}; on the fixed PAH-OMC-010 path M_psi=1, Q_n={0,...,2(n+2)}.
state_definition.charge_function: q_n(omega)=sum_(v in V_n) ell_v(omega), so Omega_(rho_(n,R,Q),Q) is the q_n=Q component.

exact_scope.graded_state_space: Omega_n^gr(R)=disjoint_union_(Q in Q_n) {Q}xOmega_(rho_(n,R,Q),Q). The grade is part of the disjoint-union tag and is not an extra interaction variable.
exact_scope.neutral_refinement: For x=(Q_f,omega_f) in Omega_(n+1)^gr(R), retain every G_n vertex aperture, phase and radial coordinate and every old edge link, drop only the new column and d_n link, recompute Q_c=sum_(v in V_n)ell_v(omega_f), and set p_(n+1,n)(x)=(Q_c,omega_f restricted to G_n).
exact_scope.charge_balance: Q_f-Q_c=sum_(v in V_(n+1)\V_n)ell_v(omega_f)>=0. No retained ell coordinate is altered and no charge is redistributed; the grade is allowed to change from Q_f to Q_c.
exact_scope.totality_and_uniqueness: Nonnegative bounded ell coordinates imply 0<=Q_c<=M_psi|V_n|, so the projected tuple is in exactly one coarse graded component. Coordinate restriction and the recomputed grade are deterministic, hence p is total and unique for every n>=2 and every R>=1.
exact_scope.generator_domain: The graded domain is the finite direct sum of the unchanged PAH-001 component domains: D_n^gr(R)=direct_sum_(Q in Q_n) bounded_functions(Omega_(rho_(n,R,Q),Q)). The block generator acts componentwise with the exact PAH-001 L_rho and every declared move preserves Q.
exact_scope.common_cylinder_algebra: A_cyl^gr is the algebraic union of bounded functions of finitely many ell_v and closed-face holonomy characters, invariant under the declared gauge action and anchor-preserving automorphisms, interpreted componentwise on the graded union. The R-488 coordinates (ell_a,ell_d,H_0,H_1) are included and are grade-independent.
exact_scope.R488_observables: ell_a with a=(0,0), ell_d with d=(1,1), H_0 and H_1 are the two closed split-triangle Z_2 characters from PAH-OMC-008. Their pointwise lifts are f composed with p and are nonzero on the graded fine domain.
exact_scope.gibbs_reference: For each grade Q retain exactly pi_(rho_(n,R,Q))=Z_(rho_(n,R,Q))^(-1)exp(-beta F_rho) from PAH-001. The graded reference is the family of these component Gibbs states; PAH-001 supplies no cross-Q mixing probabilities, so no new normalized global mixture is introduced.
exact_scope.graded_norm: Use the direct-sum family norm sum_(Q in Q_n)||f_Q||_(2,pi_(rho,Q))^2, with each component norm exactly the PAH-OMC-010 Gibbs weighted norm. A single probability measure over Q is not required for this domain-map gate and remains an explicit open modeling input if later needed.
exact_scope.csw_role: R-490 C_sw=540 is retained only as the previously verified state-weighted domination input. It is not used to define p, the graded domain, or any generator intertwining theorem.

proof_obligations.graded_totality: For every finite fine state and every n>=2,R>=1, p_(n+1,n) has a valid unique coarse grade and state.
proof_obligations.no_charge_mutation: The retained ell coordinates are identical and the dropped charge is accounted for by Q_f-Q_c, with no deletion or redistribution operation.
proof_obligations.lift_well_defined: For every R-488 cylinder f, I_(n,n+1)f=f composed with p is a total bounded observable on Omega_(n+1)^gr(R).
proof_obligations.lift_nonzero: Each of ell_a, ell_d, H_0 and H_1 has an explicit fine graded witness with nonzero lifted value and positive finite component Gibbs weight.
proof_obligations.component_recovery: Restriction of the graded direct sum to any fixed Q is definitionally the existing PAH-001 state, generator, move set, and Gibbs state.
proof_obligations.rmax_uniformity: The algebraic map proof is independent of R, and finite checks cover representative R>=1 without replacing the all-R statement by a fixed-R claim.

acceptance.primary: Hash-pin all parents, derive the graded charge bounds and balance identity, test the map on every binary ell pattern at small n and on all witness families, and verify the unchanged component functional/rates/Gibbs declarations.
acceptance.independent: Rebuild vertices, charge grading, projection, uniqueness, R-488 witnesses and component recovery without importing the primary implementation.
acceptance.hostile: Reject fixed-Q-only projection, charge deletion or redistribution, conditional Gibbs averaging, cross-Q fitted weights, rate/function changes, fixed-R_max bypass and physical promotion.
acceptance.lean: Formalize total graded charge balance, deterministic uniqueness, component recovery, nonzero lifted witness values, C_sw role and the no-promotion firewall. This is a finite algebraic cross-check, not a generator-intertwining or infinite-volume theorem.

status.scope: The full-Q graded finite domain and neutral refinement map are admitted as a source-owned researcher contract; PAH-OMC-011 generator intertwining is only eligible for a separate re-test.
status.global_normalized_gibbs_measure: NOT_DEFINED_BY_PARENT; not required for this domain-map gate

known_boundaries: The grade-changing projection does not preserve a fixed Q across levels; it preserves all retained coordinates and records the omitted charge in Q_f-Q_c.
The componentwise Gibbs family has no cross-Q mixing law. Adding one would be a new model and is outside this packet.
This packet does not prove PAH-OMC-011 generator intertwining, a common infinite-volume automorphism, a uniform continuum estimate, or an ordered limit.
R-490 C_sw=540 remains domination-only and supplies no generator equality.
The R-488 witnesses are finite cylinder witnesses; they do not select a physical sector or a unique microscopic model.
falsifiers: A valid fine state whose retained coordinates or recomputed grade fail to define a member of the coarse graded union.
Two distinct coarse graded outputs for the same fine state under the declared restriction map.
A positive-measure R-488 cylinder generator whose lift is identically zero on the graded fine domain.
A fixed-Q component whose functional, move set, generator or Gibbs weight differs from the hash-pinned PAH-001 definition.
Any need for charge redistribution, conditional averaging, a new rate, a counterterm or cross-Q fitted weight to make the map total.
missing_assumptions: If a later L2 theorem requires one normalized probability on the full disjoint union, a source-authorized cross-Q mixing law and its normalization must be supplied separately.
A separate PAH-OMC-011 re-test must still prove rootwise generator equality on this graded domain; domain totality alone is not that theorem.
non_claims: This is a researcher-owned finite domain contract, not an external source or physical authority.
MAINLINE_ADVANCE is limited to the full-Q graded finite-domain/map gate and does not close the PAH-OMC-011 intertwining gate.
No infinite-volume dynamics, continuum limit, physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.
Markov time remains external stochastic time and is not quantum real time, proper time or Lorentzian time.
The component Gibbs family is not a newly asserted global probability measure over Q, and no cross-Q mixture is fitted or assumed.
Agreement of the graded map with R-488 witnesses does not retroactively modify PAH-001 or prove a physical sector.
single_next_question: With the full-Q graded map total and unique, do the unchanged PAH-001 root tuples intertwine on the graded common cylinder without a cross-Q Gibbs mixture or any rate modification?
revisit_condition: Reopen only if the independent/hostile/Lean checks fail, a parent hash changes, a source-authorized cross-Q measure is supplied for an L2 theorem, or the dedicated PAH-OMC-011 re-test produces a rootwise counterexample.
